thread:
sara-engplatform: Heads-up: change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC for runtime pin + small infra kernel patch. Need final customer comm copy + statuspage snippet. Affected: hosted API + Dedicated nodes. @maria-support @ben-engreleases please ack.
ben-engreleases: Can we do a 2-hour pin window, then unpin if stable? Plan: canary eu-west -> us-east -> global. Also will hold canary if p95 latency spikes >10%.
maria-support: Ack. I need a short statuspage blurb and an email snippet we can send to customers (esp Dedicated). List of affected customers would be helpful.
lia-docs: Draft statuspage copy below — feel free to edit:

```
Component: Inference API - Hybrid
Status: Maintenance
Short: Scheduled maintenance to pin runtime + apply kernel patch.
When: 2026-03-22 02:00–04:00 UTC
Impact: Short degraded throughput for a subset of requests. No data loss expected.
Action: We will roll back the pin automatically if we detect increased errors or latency beyond thresholds.
```

lia-docs: Email snippet (short): "We will perform a brief maintenance window on 22 Mar 2026 02:00–04:00 UTC to apply a runtime pin and kernel patch. You may see short increases in latency or brief errors. We will post updates to status.redwood.ai and notify affected accounts."
alex-customer-success: Note: Two enterprise customers (AcmeHealth, FinGrid) are on Dedicated + private peering in eu-west — please include them on the customer-specific notice list.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: release v1.12.3 -> runtime-pin rpin-2026-03-22. Canary target: eu-west-1 (10% traffic). Window: 02:00–04:00 UTC. Job id: db-1765439998
ops-bot: Auto-hold rules: hold and alert if error_rate >= 1.0% for 10m OR p95_latency increase >= 10% for 10m. On hold -> automatic rollback to v1.12.2 after operator confirm.

sara-engplatform: @ben-engreleases can you confirm roll-forward plan if canary is healthy? Also we need the statuspage update pushed 20m before window.
ben-engreleases: If canary healthy for 20m, proceed to us-east then global. If any hold during canary, we will rollback to v1.12.2 and send postmortem brief. I'll be on pager.

maria-support: Customer-facing statuspage message ready — please use lia's copy. I'll prepare the targeted email list and the support playbook (FAQ + rollback script snippets).

You may see brief latency changes. We'll update status.redwood.ai and notify if we need to extend or rollback. Contact support@redwood.ai for urgent concerns."

ops-bot: Reminder: set alerts to notify #eng-oncall, #support and oncall PD at +1 if hold triggers.
